name: BS Lib
description: Component-oriented Bootstrap library module, with Drush commands for generating bs_base child themes.
project_description:
The BS Lib module brings Bootstrap 4 component library definitions. This module does not do anything by itself but it is used by other modules or themes.

 
 Although 8.x-1.0-rc2 claims it is Drupal 11 compatible, you should still not use it with Drupal 11. Read more about this in [#3491751-5].

 
 Additional features 
 
 Bootstrap navigation bar toggler button block. 
 Scroll to top block - can be used independently for scroll to top functionality. Block configuration offers a lot of configuration options and it assumes you will style your 'to top' link with custom CSS. 
 Improved anchor link scrolling ( doc ). 
 Drush theme generator commands for creating and updating themes. Used by bs_base contrib theme. To find out more about generator visit documentation .
 
 Drupal contribution themes that are using this module:

 
 bs_base
